purpose: A LIVE third-party transparency-log proof, frozen as pure data (no executable payload reaches proofbundle's verify path). The rootcommit vectors cover the offline anchor layering; this covers the live counterpart, a bundle issued by a log b7n0de does not operate, verified with witness keys sourced from parties other than that log. SECOND IMPLEMENTATION: tests/test_anchors_markovian_log.py carries a standalone RFC 6962 inclusion recomputation written from the spec (plain hashlib, no proofbundle.merkle) which must reproduce the checkpoint root before proofbundle.tlogproof.verify_tlog_proof is consulted at all, so the two derivations cannot silently drift into each other. NO-OVERCLAIM: (1) leaf 7271 is the log's own stream statement, not an entry we submitted, so the public POST /submit path is NOT exercised here; (2) the three ML-DSA-44 lines in the bundle are NOT verified, because this fixture carries no ML-DSA-44 verifier key for any of them, so there is nothing to recompute against and the optional proofbundle[pq] backend does not change that; two of the three keys would have to come from the witness operators (navigli, ring-any-bells), and the third carries the log's own origin name, so an INDEPENDENT key for it cannot be obtained at all without leaning on the audited log; (3) rgdd.se/poc-witness and witness1.smartit.nu/witness1 cosigned but their operators' own pages were unreachable, so their keys are deliberately not carried and they are not counted toward the quorum; (4) one bundle is a snapshot and says nothing about split-view behaviour over time.
spec: https://c2sp.org/tlog-proof (development version on main as of 2026-08-14; no tagged v1.0.0, unlike tlog-checkpoint / tlog-witness / tlog-cosignature)

upstream.author: Markovian Protocol / Colin <hello@quantsynth.net>
upstream.provenance_note: A live endpoint, not a git commit: /proof/7271 served tree size 7340 on 2026-08-13 and 7341 on 2026-08-14, because the checkpoint moves with the log. Provenance is therefore pinned by retrieval time plus the per-file digests below, not by an upstream revision.
upstream.verification: Verified by b7n0de/proofbundle on 2026-08-14 in two independent passes. Pass one, a standalone RFC 6962 recomputation self-tested against 249 synthetic inclusion paths over tree sizes 1 to 7341 before touching the bundle, reproduced the checkpoint root from the leaf bytes. Pass two, proofbundle 3.7.0 verify-proof --threshold 4, returned ok/log_ok/witnesses_ok/inclusion_ok all true. Flipping one payload bit split the verdict exactly at inclusion_ok.

files.case: the frozen c2sp.org/tlog-proof bundle as served by the log: header, index, 11-node inclusion path, signed checkpoint, 11 signature lines
files.expect: parses; its checkpoint root is reproduced from leaf_7271.raw by the standalone RFC 6962 recomputation in the test module and by proofbundle.merkle

files.case: the exact raw leaf bytes for index 7271, as served by /leaf/7271
files.expect: SHA-256(0x00 || these bytes) equals the recorded leaf hash; any single-byte change flips inclusion_ok to false while log_ok and witnesses_ok stay true

files.case: the log vkey plus five witness vkeys, each taken from a party other than the audited log; per-line source comments
files.expect: every key ID recomputes as SHA-256(name || 0x0A || algbyte || pubkey)[:4]; not one line comes from the log's own /policy

files.case: recorded --json output of the positive run, proofbundle 3.7.0 verify-proof --threshold 4
files.note: The byte identity is bound to the version named in `case`. Measured at 3.8.0 with the same invocation: every key of this file is reproduced with the same value, and the live output carries one ADDITIONAL key, `expected_origin` (null when --expected-origin is not passed). So this file remains a correct record of what 3.7.0 emitted and is no longer a byte-for-byte prediction of what the current version emits. Recorded here rather than regenerating the file, because the fixture is frozen on purpose: it is the reference point of several audit records, and a fixture that moves with the code cannot contradict the code.
files.expect: ok=true, log_ok=true, witnesses_ok=true, inclusion_ok=true, five ed25519-cosignature/v1 witnesses

files.case: recorded --json output of the counter-test, byte 365 of the payload XOR 0x01
files.expect: ok=false, inclusion_ok=false, while log_ok=true and witnesses_ok=true; the tampered payload itself is generated at test time, never vendored
